trueMuseumMeshContact.meaning: The old fascia plinth already met its old ground. A contiguous southwest frontage has less exposed plinth, not an entire floating house fixed.

coastAndParkingGeometry.scope: Protect the full W/Q piecewise-linear ground+flight support rectangle, including a whole fine triangle neighbor in every direction. Parking source tested as full official game polygons+holes and rim, not nearest vertex alone. Coastal signed-distance bound uses every underlying raw byte that may contribute to any bilinear pixel in this entire rectangle; positive geospatial controls supplement an empty class-2 parking/water evaluation cohort, they are not new original LiDAR Z judgements.

shadeAndLightRegression.scope: Prospectively fixed regression against the original visually identified V3 artifact (not a new blind geodata split). The exact shade-off capture separates the observed undergrass light leak from the triangular emerging legacy-cast shadow. This does not expect new legitimate canopy illumination to be zero; it tests unnatural sharpness at previously observed geometry-contour boundaries. Must separately preserve opacity on fully supported shade and outside all affected surfaces.
shadeAndLightRegression.visualAcceptance: No prior 12-level light punctures remain; reject an unexplained new large single-channel leak in the fixed low-contrast ground. Hard canopy emergence boundary should substantially weaken: at least 80% of original >=8-level artificial neighbor jumps should drop below or equal to 8, median gradient <=4 u8 and 90th percentile <=8, followed by independent image judgement edge vs real foliage. If a single-pixel high-frequency residual remains, classify it rather than erase a real silhouette. Both original and revised endpoint surfaces and stock texture/opacity stay authentic.
